en-US.headline:
The notch
disappears.
en-US.sub: Forget it, in a couple of taps.
en-US.body: On an OLED screen a black pixel is an off pixel, so the black the app draws is optically the same as the panel around the camera. The cutout does not get covered up. It stops existing.

en-US.headline:
Export it,
free.
en-US.sub: Keep the image, or share it.
en-US.body: PNG at the exact resolution of your screen, and never JPEG. JPEG makes block artefacts where the black meets the image, and those artefacts are precisely what makes a cutout reappear.
